_meta.label: Concept Angle
_meta.instruction: The central reason-to-care is the variable under test. The selected angle should determine the headline proposition, support, and which product truths are emphasized. Do not mention the angle once and then write a generic ad. Do not change factual product claims.

pain_point.label: Pain Point
pain_point.definition: Focus on an existing frustration. Structure: pain, then consequence, then the relevant product support. Use persona-specific pain.

desired_outcome.label: Desired Outcome
desired_outcome.definition: Lead with what the person wants to achieve. Do not automatically promise the outcome. Use designed-to-help language when required by product truth.
desired_outcome.skeleton: Desired future → how the product supports it

social_proof.label: Social Proof
social_proof.definition: Lead with verified adoption, user counts, or similar proof from the product document. Never generate proof.
social_proof.skeleton: Verified proof → buyer relevance → result or mechanism

authority.label: Authority
authority.definition: Lead with verified expertise, origin, credentials, or institutional association supplied in the product document.

curiosity.label: Curiosity
curiosity.definition: Lead with a useful knowledge gap, then resolve it. Do not use meaningless clickbait.

comparison.label: Comparison
comparison.definition: Contrast approaches, routines, or product structures. Do not demean competitors or make unsupported superiority claims.
comparison.skeleton: Harder alternative vs this path → less-sacrifice detail

offer.label: Offer
offer.definition: Lead with a legitimate supplied offer such as a money-back policy or bundle. If offer facts are missing, do not invent one.
offer.skeleton: Reason to act → what is included or reduced-risk

mechanism.label: Mechanism
mechanism.definition: Focus on why or how the product supports the desired behavior or outcome. Stay inside verified product truths.
mechanism.skeleton: How it works → why that helps this persona

structure.label: Structure
structure.definition: Focus on systemization: day-wise steps, food guidance, a fixed routine. Excellent for confused or failed-diet personas.
structure.skeleton: The system → why structure reduces guesswork

ease.label: Ease
ease.definition: Focus on practicality or simplicity. Only use supported ease claims. Do not make it sound effortless.
ease.skeleton: What is simpler → the supported reason it fits daily life

accountability.label: Accountability
accountability.definition: Focus on coaching, check-ins, guidance, or consistency support from the product document.
accountability.skeleton: Support system → why consistency gets easier

objection.label: Objection
objection.definition: Address the reason this persona is hesitant, then answer with product truth. Do not guarantee it works for everyone.
objection.skeleton: The hesitation → reframe → relevant product truth

product_differentiation.label: Product Differentiation
product_differentiation.definition: Explain what category the product actually belongs to. Avoid attacking other products.
product_differentiation.skeleton: What it is not → what it actually is → why that matters
